comparison.objective: Join two strips with a blind rivet, snap the stem, bin it, and return the riveter; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Insert a rivet, keep the riveter square, pump until stem fracture, and manage waste versus support and level a rail, latch spring prongs, telescope, and drive screws.
comparison.success_condition: Requires a properly set rivet, stem disposal, tool return, and no crooked pull; candidate requires intended rack holes, full springs, bottom screws, and self-support.
comparison.reason: Both use a fastening tool, but riveting material layers and installing a preformed rail assembly are meaningfully different tests.
